name: backlog
description: Backlog triage, then the work: blind judges sort the issues (fix, close, ask, later), Claude picks the ones to fix, a fixer per pick with its test and a reviewer, then Claude reviews each

stages.prompt:
Here the bar is triage. For each issue below, by the id it is given, return an action: fix (real and worth doing now), close (not real, done, or not worth it), ask (it needs the user's answer) or later; and why, in a sentence.
